name: Universidad de Navarra
summary: Private university in Pamplona with its own IB route; degrees are taught in Spanish and English, with English-taught tracks but none fully in English.

ib.text: IB route: predicted grades after DP year 1 must reach each school's minimum (30 to 37 points; Medicine 37 with HL Biology and Chemistry at 6), then an interview. Degrees are in Spanish and English.

dates.label: December period deadline (international Medicine applicants apply now)
March period deadline, all degrees; after it only degrees with places left
IB route: final IB grades due before this date, unless shared from your application

notes: English-taught tracks sit inside Spanish degrees: the International Science Program, Medicine's International Program (English in year 1 and part of year 2) and bilingual Economics.
The IB route still needs UNEDasiss accreditation to enrol, and students outside Spain also interview with a delegate in their country.
If you miss your IB target you may ask to be reconsidered through the admission tests, except in the School of Medicine.
